findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: groundtruth_scan_coin, groundtruth_creator_flag · Private data: groundtruth_scan_coin, groundtruth_screen_creator, groundtruth_creator_flag, groundtruth_wallet_record, groundtruth_copycheck, groundtruth_kol_board, groundtruth_kol_feed, groundtruth_seal_call, groundtruth_scorecard · Public sink: groundtruth_scoreboard, groundtruth_census_figures.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: groundtruth_scan_coin, groundtruth_creator_flag · Private data: groundtruth_scan_coin, groundtruth_screen_creator, groundtruth_creator_flag, groundtruth_wallet_record, groundtruth_copycheck, groundtruth_kol_board, groundtruth_kol_feed, groundtruth_seal_call, groundtruth_scorecard · Public sink: groundtruth_scoreboard, groundtruth_census_figures

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
